methodSections.heading: Creamy Fudge
steps: Soak the cashews in water for 3-4 hours or until they are very soft.
Gently melt the coconut oil in double boiler or dehydrator.
Blend or process all ingredients, starting with ⅓ Cup of water, until smooth and creamy. Add a touch more water if necessary.
Pour mixture into a glass dish roughly 22cm (9in) square, spread out evenly and cover.
Chill in the fridge overnight or in the freezer for one hour.
